entities.name: Remedello culture
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The Remedello culture developed during the Copper Age in Northern Italy, particularly in the area of the Po Valley. The name comes from the town of Remedello (Brescia) where several burials were discovered in the late 19th century.
